name: Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning
definition: A strategy to address excessive Gaussian production and overfitting in single-view gradient-based densification by leveraging multi-view guidance.
summary: Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by using multi-view consistency metrics to control Gaussian count, preventing the redundancy and overfitting caused by single-view gradient methods.
